videos.title: Is the Yellowstone volcano going to erupt again? 🌋
videos.author: CrashCourse
videos.description:
Yellowstone’s last supereruption was around 640,000 years ago, and geologists say there’s an “exceedingly low” chance that a supereruption would happen in the next few thousand years—  or possibly ever again. So don't worry. You can enjoy your Yellowstone trip in peace!
